Pakistan Hockey Team to Participate in India's Asian Champions Trophy

Pakistan's national hockey team will participate in the upcoming Asian Champions Trophy to be held in Chennai, India. The confirmation of their participation came after Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann stated that the team would play in the tournament. The event is scheduled to take place in the Indian city of Chennai.
